visual_reviews.liberty-01: Single dog standing beside a seated person in an office; dark archival image.

visual_reviews.collies-02: Same owner-named pair on a wooded path in a later photograph; one seated and one resting.

visual_reviews.buffy-yume-02: Both same named dogs interact with a seated person in snow; a separate exposure in the same session.

exposure: No selected photograph has received BreedFrame classifier inference before this registration. Identity-disjoint from prior evaluated cases. Public-image training overlap unknown. Excluded Fala sculpture images were visually reviewed in earlier curation without inference. Archive-heavy convenience selection; no population estimate.

exclusions.Rex: Source identifies Cavalier King Charles Spaniel; exact correspondence to the published label taxonomy was not assumed.
exclusions.Heidi: Available images appear to derive from the same dated press-conference photograph; independent exposures not established.
exclusions.Doug the Pug: Search returned one exposure and its crop; no pair established.
exclusions.Him and Her: The candidate greeting image is dated 1966-03-18 but names Her, whose death the LBJ Library dates to 1964. Group identity is inconsistent.
exclusions.Sunny: Retrieved images also contain previously evaluated Bo; excluded to preserve identity separation.
exclusions.hachiko-statue-02: Cats at the sculpture feet; insufficient view of the dog depiction for the intended paired control.
exclusions.hachiko-statue-04: Another distant crowded view; the selected measuring photograph supplies a closer distinct view.
